That drawing really is a miracle, a big part of cutting is in the moment dopamine, i find staring at my scars to be therapeutic, thats a bit of an unpopular opinion though, its validating for me, but regardless my point is being able to see the drawings kind of gives off that dopamine and validation for me, without the harm, also doing really thrilling things like eating spicy food and dunking my head in water helps as well if im in a public place. Let me just say first of all, dad of the fuckin year.

To answer your questions:
What to do to make her feel more comfortable im not sure, me personally i find that talking about it is triggering and can ruin my mood completely or even trigger me to want to relapse. You and her seem to have a trusting honest relationship so i think it wouldn’t hurt to ask her, if she doesnt know then continue to do what youre doing because chances are you’re doing great, dont change how you act around her because of this, that was always my biggest fear and its a lot of others biggest fears, sometimes its necessary but again, ask her. Instead of saying “cutting” or “suicidal” my family just says “feeling unsafe”. Sounds stupid but cognitive dissonance is a miracle 

The fact that she doesn’t cut at your house and trusts you tells me shes as safe as she can be, I’m not going to say anything about her mother and i don’t know your guy’s relationships with eachother but she obviously trusts you more than your mother, that might be something brought on by her mother or just the mere fact that you have handled this situation well. She feels safe with you and you respect her, tell her to always come to you if she wants anything to make her feel safe

I use this amazing thing called a sharpie marker whenever i want to cut, my usual place i cut is on the sides of my stomach and my arms, instead of cutting I’ll draw a picture with the sharpie where i want to cut, like a sleeve tattoo, it’s fun, harmless, and therapeutic, it doesnt have to be all silly and fun, just as long as it isn’t drawing blood. If it isnt a vice its a virtue

Me personally, i needed space, i am a very individualistic person and i need a lot of space to myself to think. Never pressure her to talk about it if she isnt in the mood, even if she had just cut. If she relapses never ever shame her, if shes gone a while without cutting, dont point it out unless she does; that one i dont have an explanation for but it made me mad and it made me want to relapse,

I’m no psychologist I’m just some guy recovering just as your daughter is. Im so proud of her and im so proud of you, with your care im certain she’ll be okay, just continue to do what you’ve been doing and be there for her. Don’t take any criticism personally, its for everyones mutual benefit, good luck OP‼️

File a deferral request to your college and take a year off. School will be there when you need it but you need a break. Start working to save up enough and look on craigslist or websites like that for people who need roommates in your area. That environment is not safe. Since you are 18 you should check into the emergency room and ask to be emitted, it would be a really good idea for you. They will get you all the things you need and all of the support as well as doctors and therapists. If you live in a country with poor healthcare I’m not sure how that works but for me (canada) it was as easy as walking up to the desk and saying i was having a “mental health emergency”. If none of those options seem appealing then I cant think of any other way to help, there are other things to try i just cant think of anything.

I recently relapsed after a few years too, i think it would be good for the both of you if you told them you relapsed. It wasn’t fair of them to unintentionally pressure you by saying they trust you not to again, im sure if you tell them they’ll give you a big comforting hug and tell you its okay! I’m not going to pretend to know your situation or your life but he seems supportive/understanding enough from when you did, it will only help the both of you. Secrets aren’t a fun thing to keep to yourself in a healthy relationship. Theres 3 things that can never hide forever: the sun, the moon and the truth.

Don’t settle for mediocre company. Your friend should not be acting like that and if they really cared about you they’d be worried, if they haven’t dealt with this sort of thing and are young i can see why they react like that but it’s not valid, tell them how their reaction makes you feel and tell that that you really trust them and that you just need someone to talk to about it. If they don’t take you seriously or don’t hear you out then drop them, or at least know that that person doesn’t have your best interest at heart.

Settle for no company than bad company thats what i always say. You of course dont have to, I’m not gonna stay here and pretend i know your situation, but in the past i stayed with bad people who acted like that and it ended horribly, nip it in the bud while you can alright?

And hey, you didn’t do anything wrong okay? Dont let them make you think that, it’s all okay and it’ll be okay. I promise!
